issues.on_page: Combining schedule p8: Operation and maintenance of plant, Reclassifications (160,000); p7 Nonrevenue receipts 'Transfers from other funds' Depreciation 160,000 / Reclassifications (160,000); p14 Depreciation 'Transfer from General Fund' 160,000
issues.issue: [fixed] Hidden transfer not handled. The Depreciation Fund detail records +160,000 'Transfer from General Fund' (other financing), but the General Fund budget schedule (pp11-13) has only the 140,000 'Transfer to other funds' line (matched by School Nutrition 115,000 + Activities 25,000). The other 160,000 sits inside the General Fund's Operation and maintenance of plant spending (2610/2620/2630 = 648,238), which the combining schedule removes through its Reclassifications column (648,238 + 217,513 - 160,000 = 705,751). So the 160,000 is counted as General Fund spending and spent again by Depreciation. Under the hidden-transfer rule, add a contra expenditure line of -160,000 (department 'Operation and maintenance of plant', split_from naming 2610/2620/2630 and p8, review) and an other financing line of -160,000 for the General Fund. Right now the detail other financing nets to +160,000 instead of 0.

issues.issue: The report doesn't agree with itself. The combining schedule assigns 77,406 of Depreciation spending to student transportation, but the fund's own schedule shows that figure only as the 2024 actual, so the function split on p4 (Student transportation 344,612; O&M 705,751) may be misallocated in the report. Totals still agree (217,513 + 77,406 = 294,919).
This could be fines and forfeitures: it is fine and license money passed through by the county. The current category is defensible.

Combining schedule pp6-7 shows the General Fund's 89,371 is 76,788 other nonrevenue receipts + 11,783 Depreciation other non-revenue + 100 'Other' + 700 local license fees. The line mixes in licenses (700); it's kept as printed with review, which is fine. The review text could name the license fees.

The function (capital outlay) and object (rent/leases) pairing is a judgment call: 400,000 of building rental paid from the Special Building Fund (budget 1,220,000) may be a lease-purchase payment, which would be debt service. Same question for disbursements[9] (capital outlay). Review flag already set.
'Special items' is an object line in an itemized list, not a function total. 'not itemized' doesn't fit; 'miscellaneous expenditure' (with review) would be the matching last-resort string.
